name: acl-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ACL (Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics) submissions built around ACL Rolling Review: cycle selection, ARR submission checks, author response, commitment strategy, camera-ready, artifacts, reproducibility, the Responsible NLP checklist, writing style, related work, experiments, and workflow. Grounded in the ACL 2027 main-conference call, aclrollingreview.org CFP, cycle calendar and sustainable-reviewing policy (re-verified 2026-11-23), OpenReview ARR groups, and the ACL Anthology.
